notes: Wadekar & Wang (arXiv:2111.08025): constraints from gas heating of the Leo T dwarf galaxy on DM decay/annihilation. The paper's ALP result (Fig. 4) constrains the axion-photon coupling g_agamma for decaying ALP dark matter over ma ~ 26.2 eV - 1 keV, strongest existing bound in ~30 eV - 1 keV at time of publication. The pre-analysis hint of DarkPhoton refers to the earlier WF21 paper; this paper's relevant new exclusion is on g_agamma (AxionPhoton). Numerical data points are approximate reconstructions from the described figure behavior and the a->gamma gamma decay-lifetime bounds (tau_min in Fig. 3) converted via Gamma = m_a^3 g^2 / 64 pi; the paper provides public data files on GitHub which should be preferred for precise values. No local (solar-neighborhood) DM density is assumed - the bound uses the Leo T DM halo profile (Burkert fit of Faerman et al. 2013), so dm_density_assumed is null. No explicit statistical confidence level is quoted (conservative calorimetric bound requiring DM heating <= gas cooling rate). | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.5, 8))
